items.title: What Does Marvell Technology (MRVL) Gain From A $115 Billion All Stock Deal?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (NasdaqGS:MRVL) announced a US$115b all-stock acquisition of Lumentum Holdings on 4 November 2026. The transaction is structured entirely in equity, with Lumentum shareholders set to receive Marvell stock instead of cash. Management highlighted optical technologies for AI data center infrastructure as a key rationale for combining the two businesses.
